title: Automating detection of Two-Level Systems in Superconducting Qubits
summary: Microscopic two-level system (TLS) defects remain a primary mechanism of decoherence and operational instability in superconducting transmon qubits, necessitating scalable and automated methods for their characterization. Here, we present and benchmark two complementary analysis pipelines for extracting TLS statistics directly from time-resolved SWAP spectroscopy: one-dimensional decay-rate fitting (1D-DRF), which detects defects via localized enhancements in the qubit relaxation rate, and a deterministic, non-parametric computer-vision framework (2D-CV) that achieves two-dimensional…
